title: Important Notice for All Students
text:
Dear Students,
This is a final reminder to avail the extended deadline for fee submission, which is valid until June 19, 2026, as approved by the Honorable Vice Chancellor.
All students are strongly advised to take advantage of this final opportunity and ensure that their outstanding dues are cleared within the given timeframe. Please note that failure to submit the fee by the revised deadline may result in the withholding of results and the imposition of a penalty of Rs. 1,000 per day.
📌 Need Assistance?
For any queries or support regarding fee submission, please contact the Students’ Cell at the Treasurer’s Office.
Regards,
